details.effect: Select an enemy follower on the field. Deal it 3 damage and give [attack]+1 to each follower that costs 1 or less on your field.

issues: The second step is incorrectly encoded as buffing Abysscraft followers and using otherOnly. It should buff each follower that costs 1 or less on your field by +1 attack; encode a field buff targeting your followers with maxCost 1 and no exclude-self restriction.

details.cardSet: Combined Set "Worldreaver's Descent & Dominion of Darkness"
details.effect: [fanfare] Search your deck for a Nano, the Dawnblade, summon it, then shuffle. Whenever a Nano, the Dawnblade on your field evolves, choose one. (1) Put a Twilight Blade token into your EX area. (2) Give your leader [defense]+2.

options.label: Put a Twilight Blade token into your EX area

issues: The onAllyEvolve ability incorrectly places the evolved-card restriction in a top-level 'filter' field. It should trigger only when a Nano, the Dawnblade on your field evolves; encode the restriction in a supported way rather than an unsupported wrapper field, so the ability only triggers from that named ally's evolve.

source.name: Lelouch, Leader of the Black Knights

details.effect: [fanfare] Necrocharge (10): Select up to 2 [abysscraft] followers that cost 2 play points or less in your cemetery and put them onto your field. Give each other follower on your field [attack]+1/[defense]+1. NC (20): Give [attack]+3/[defense]+3 instead. While this card is on your field, each [abysscraft] follower on your field has Rush.

issues: The fanfare is encoded as two separate abilities, causing the NC(20) version to also stack with the NC(10) version. It should be a single fanfare that summons up to 2 qualifying followers, then gives each other follower on your field +3/+3 if Necrocharge (20), otherwise +1/+1 if Necrocharge (10).
summonFromCemetery incorrectly uses maxTotalCost: 2. The source says up to 2 followers that each cost 2 or less, not total cost 2; remove maxTotalCost.
The buff step incorrectly limits the buff to Abysscraft followers. It should give each other follower on your field +1/+1 or +3/+3 regardless of class.

The passive Rush aura is encoded with cardClass at the top level of auraGrantKeyword, which is not a supported field for that operation. It should grant Rush to each Abysscraft follower on your field using a supported filtering field.
